title: Service of Notices through Registered Post Acknowledgment Due

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint against a company, and the District Commission serves a notice to the company through registered post acknowledgment due.
content.outcome: The notice is deemed to be served as per Section 65(1) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, which requires that all notices be served by delivering or transmitting a copy thereof by registered post acknowledgment due addressed to the opposite party.

user_queries: What is the mode of service of notices under the Consumer Protection Act?
Can a notice be served through electronic means?
What is the relevance of registered post acknowledgment due in serving notices?
